THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 438 CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE EVENT OF HIS ARREST IN CR.NO.149/2023 OF CHANDRA LAYOUT POLICE STATION, BENGALURU ON THE FILE OF THE 4th ACMM AT BENGALURU FOR THE OFFENCES P/U/Ss.120-B,
406, 419, 420, 465, 468, 471, 503 R/W SEC.34 OF IPC 1860 WHEREIN THE PETITIONER HEREIN IS ARRAIGNED AS ACCUSED NO.12 AND THE LXVIII ADDITIONAL CITY CIVIL AND SESSIONS JUDGE, BENGALURU CITY HAS DISMISSED THE BAIL PETITION ON 10.07.2023 IN CRL.MISC.NO.5601/2023.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a memo praying permission of the Court to withdraw the petition.
The memo is placed on record In view of the memo, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.

Sd/-
JUDGE KGR*
